name: Sina Extension for Elementor
author: Sina Extra

sections.description:
Sina Extension is an all-in-one addon for Elementor that brings custom builders, widgets, and design features to your website. It includes Header Builder, Footer Builder, Theme Builder, Popup Builder, Sidebar Builder, and Shortcode Generator to help you create dynamic websites visually.

The plugin comes with 58 custom Elementor elements and detailed styling controls, allowing you to build headers, footers, popups, sidebars, single pages, archive pages, search pages, 404 pages, and other website templates using drag and drop.

Sina Extension also provides 100+ free ready-made templates to help you build websites faster. Whether you are creating business, portfolio, blog, agency, or any other websites, the plugin helps you design and display content more effectively without writing code.

Using Sina Templates

Features

  • Header Builder.
  • Footer Builder.
  • Popup Builder.
  • Sidebar Builder.
  • Theme Builder.
  • Shortcode Generator.
  • 58 free elements.
  • 100+ responsive ready-made templates.
  • Enable or disable elements from the options panel.
  • Detailed styling and customization controls.
  • Easy drag and drop editing.
  • Free support through the forum and our support desk.

What Can You Create?

You can create professional website layouts, dynamic templates, and custom designs visually without coding.
See demo

Support

Need help? Please create a support ticket

HEADER AND FOOTER WIDGETS

  1. [Nav Menu]: Display navigation menus with dropdown support.
  2. [Site Logo]: Show the site logo in the header area.
  3. [Site Info]: Display the site title, tagline or copyright on Header or Footer.
  4. [Direct Contact]: Show phone and email contact links on the Header or Footer.
  5. [Search]: Add a search button to the Header.
  6. [Quick Links]: Display the quick menu links on Header or Footer.
  7. [Scroll to Top]: Add a scroll to top button to the footer.
  8. [Woo Cart]: Add the WooCommerce cart button to the header.

THEME BUILDER WIDGETS

  1. [Post Title]: Display the post title dynamically on single pages.
  2. [Post Content]: Show the post content automatically on single pages.
  3. [Post Featured Image]: Display featured images dynamically within single templates.
  4. [Post Excerpt]: Show post excerpts and summaries dynamically.
  5. [Post Meta]: Display post meta such as author, date, and categories.
  6. [Post Navigation]: Add previous and next post navigation dynamically.
  7. [Post Comments]: Display the comment section automatically on single pages.
  8. [Archive Title]: Show archive titles dynamically on archive pages.
  9. [Author Profile]: Display author information on single and archive pages.
  10. [Posts]: Display posts dynamically on archive and search pages.

FREE WIDGETS

  1. Accordion: Display FAQs and custom content using accordion widget.
  2. Banner Slider: Create animated text and image sliders for your website.
  3. Blogpost: Display blog posts in grid, masonry, or list layouts.
  4. Brand Carousel: Show client logos and brand images in a carousel.
  5. Breadcrumbs: Show breadcrumbs to navigate the site easily.
  6. Contact Form: Create beautiful contact forms with flexible styling options.
  7. Content Box: Display services, features, or custom content with flexible layouts.
  8. Content Slider: Show any content or Elementor template in an interactive slider.
  9. Countdown: Add countdown timers to your website.
  10. Counter: Show animated numbers and statistics.
  11. Dynamic Button: Add static or dynamic buttons using pages, posts, categories, or tags.
  12. Facebook Feed: Display Facebook feeds directly on your website.
  13. Fancy Text: Use animated text with 45+ animation effects.
  14. Flip Box: Highlight content using interactive flip box effects.
  15. Google Map: Add Google Maps with 20+ color styles.
  16. Image Differ: Compare before and after images with vertical or horizontal layouts.
  17. Login Form: Show custom login forms anywhere on your website.
  18. MailChimp: Create Mailchimp subscription forms to grow your email list.
  19. Modal Box: Display Elementor templates inside modal boxes with 45+ animation effects.
  20. News Ticker: Show scrolling news and post titles.
  21. Particle Layer: Add animated particle backgrounds with multiple styles and effects.
  22. Piechart: Display animated circular charts and percentage indicators.
  23. Portfolio: Showcase your portfolio projects with multiple layouts.
  24. Posts Carousel: Display recent posts in responsive carousel, full-width, or grid layouts.
  25. Posts Tab: Show posts in organized tab layouts.
  26. Pricing: Display pricing plans and service packages beautifully.
  27. Product Zoomer: Show product images with zoom functionality.
  28. Progressbar: Display progress bars with different styles.
  29. Review Carousel: Show customer reviews in a carousel.
  30. Search Form: Create custom styled search forms for your website.
  31. Social Icons: Add social icons for Facebook, X, LinkedIn, and more.
  32. Table: Display data and information using customizable tables.
  33. Team: Show team members with professional layouts.
  34. Title: Display titles, subtitles, and descriptions anywhere on your website.
  35. Transform: Create interactive content with 2D and 3D transform effects.
  36. Twitter Feed: Display Twitter feeds on your website.
  37. User Counter: Show the total number of registered users.
  38. Video: Play videos inside popup windows.
  39. Visit Counter: Display page visit statistics.

FREE EXTENDERS

  1. Morphing Animation: Apply morphing animations to any Elementor widget or content.

PRO WIDGETS

  1. Chart: Visualize statistics using bar, line, pie, and other chart types.
  2. Facebook Feed Carousel: Show Facebook feeds in responsive carousel layouts.
  3. Hover Image: Add attractive hover effects to images.
  4. Image Accordion: Display images and content using interactive accordion layouts.
  5. Image Marker: Highlight specific areas and hotspots within an image.
  6. Image Scroller: Create smooth scrolling previews for images.
  7. Instant Search: Display AJAX search forms with instant search results.
  8. Lost Password Form: Create custom lost password forms and show them anywhere on your website.
  9. Lottie Animation: Add engaging Lottie animations to your website.
  10. Offcanvas Bar: Add menus, widgets, or custom content inside an offcanvas bar.
  11. Posts Gallery: Display posts in creative gallery layouts.
  12. Posts Load On Scroll: Load posts dynamically with AJAX infinite scrolling in grid, list, and thumb layouts.
  13. Register Form: Build custom user registration forms anywhere on your website.
  14. Section Navigation: Add fixed navigation for smooth section scrolling.
  15. Source Code: Display and highlight source code with syntax styling.
  16. Tab: Show content inside responsive tab layouts.
  17. Team Carousel: Present team members in an interactive carousel.
  18. Testimonial: Display customer testimonials in an interactive carousel.
  19. Thumb Carousel: Create image carousels with thumbnail navigation.
  20. Tilt Box: Show content and images with interactive tilt effects.
  21. Toggle Content: Display content inside toggle tabs or switchers.
  22. Twitter Feed Carousel: Show Twitter feeds in responsive carousel layouts.
  23. Video Gallery: Display video galleries with popup playback support.

WOOCOMMERCE WIDGETS

  1. Shop Box Grid: Display WooCommerce products in box grid layouts.
  2. Shop List Grid: Show WooCommerce products in list view.
  3. Shop Thumb Grid: Present WooCommerce products in thumbnail grid designs.
  4. Shop Box Carousel: Display WooCommerce products in box carousel format.
  5. Shop List Carousel: Show WooCommerce products in list carousel style.
  6. Shop Thumb Carousel: Present WooCommerce products with thumbnail carousel navigation.
  7. Products Filter Vertical: Create vertical product search and filtering interfaces.
  8. Products Filter Horizontal: Build horizontal product search and filter layouts.
  9. Cart: Create custom WooCommerce cart pages with Elementor.
  10. Checkout: Build custom WooCommerce checkout pages visually.

PRO EXTENDERS

  1. Clips Animation: Apply clipping animations to images.
  2. Colors Animation: Create animated color backgrounds and gradients.
  3. Conditional Publish: Show or hide content based on specific conditions.
  4. Content Protection: Restrict content visibility based on user roles.
  5. Grid Animation: Add smooth grid-based animations to sections.
  6. Masker: Apply masking effects to images and content.
  7. Parallax: Create parallax scrolling effects for sections and backgrounds.
  8. Preloader: Add customizable preloaders to your website.
  9. Reading Progressbar: Display reading progress indicators based on page scrolling.
  10. Section Particles: Add animated particle effects to any section.
  11. Sticky: Make sections and elements sticky on scroll.
  12. Water Ripples: Create interactive water ripple effects for container and section backgrounds.

Translation Ready

The plugin is translation ready and currently includes translations for:

  • Bengali
  • French
  • German
  • Portuguese

sections.installation:
Note: Sina Extension requires Elementor to be installed and activated.

  1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Search for “Sina” in the Elementor editor to access all available widgets.
  4. You can also find them under the “Sina Extension” category in the Elementor widget panel.
sections.faq:
Can I use the plugin without Elementor Page Builder?

No. Sina Extension is an addon for Elementor and requires Elementor to be installed and activated.

Can I use the plugin with any WordPress theme?

Yes. Sina Extension works with any WordPress theme that is compatible with Elementor.

Can I use it free?

Yes. The free version is available on WordPress.org. A PRO version is also available with additional widgets, features, and advanced functionality.

short_description: A collection of advanced features including Header & Footer Builder, Theme Builder, Popup Builder, 58 elements, 100+ free templates and more.
description:
Sina Extension is an all-in-one addon for Elementor that brings custom builders, widgets, and design features to your website. It includes Header Builder, Footer Builder, Theme Builder, Popup Builder, Sidebar Builder, and Shortcode Generator to help you create dynamic websites visually.

The plugin comes with 58 custom Elementor elements and detailed styling controls, allowing you to build headers, footers, popups, sidebars, single pages, archive pages, search pages, 404 pages, and other website templates using drag and drop.

Sina Extension also provides 100+ free ready-made templates to help you build websites faster. Whether you are creating business, portfolio, blog, agency, or any other websites, the plugin helps you design and display content more effectively without writing code.

Using Sina Templates

Features

  • Header Builder.
  • Footer Builder.
  • Popup Builder.
  • Sidebar Builder.
  • Theme Builder.
  • Shortcode Generator.
  • 58 free elements.
  • 100+ responsive ready-made templates.
  • Enable or disable elements from the options panel.
  • Detailed styling and customization controls.
  • Easy drag and drop editing.
  • Free support through the forum and our support desk.

What Can You Create?

You can create professional website layouts, dynamic templates, and custom designs visually without coding.
See demo

Support

Need help? Please create a support ticket
